body.x: Korean Electronic Industry Exhibition, the largest electronics and IT trade show in Korea, had its grand opening on Oct. 26 at COEX Hall. It is the show that encompasses Korea Electronics Show(KES 2016), International Semiconductor Exhibition, and International Meeting of Information Display.

Korean Electronic Industry Exhibition is the trade show that introduces the visitors to experience the next-gen convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health. It is hosted by Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy(MOTIE) and organized by Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy(MOTIE), Korea Electronics Association, Korea Semiconductor Industry Association, and Korea Display Industry Association.

Beginning with the opening keynote that proposed the future technology in electronic cars and IoT, 30 events including electronic engineering symposium, wearable industry seminar, International Meeting on Information Display(IMID) business forum, and new product presentation have been prepared. Also, 400 guests in electronics and IT industries attended the opening ceremony of this show.
At the opening ceremony, 40 contributors to the development of electronics and IT industries have been awarded, including the CFO of LG Electronics and the executive director of Samsung Electronics.

Jung Do-hyun, CFO and Corporate Business Administration Officer of LG Electronics, received the award for contributing to the global power by active investment in training, stable financial structure, implementation and standardization in all business areas for sustainable management.

A wide array of the latest electronics and IT devices including the world's first smartphone with wide-angle lens on both sides, TV that can also serve as furniture, the world's largest 21:1 monitor and IoT-related technology including smart home, healthcare, environment, energy, finance, and smart car have been exhibited.

In the exhibit Smart factory & Biz Info, finished products, parts, and software from 180 venture companies have been submitted for exhibition. Also, there will be consultation for smart factory implementation to help out the smaller companies that cannot afford to build a full-sized production facility.
About 600 original IT technologies developed from academic-industrial cooperation have been revealed, proving the possibilities of outcome by such cooperation.

This year, automobile convergence alliance special hall has been prepared for the first time to introduce the latest trend in the convergence of automobiles and electronics. MOTIE has made automobile convergence alliance last year to further develop this field, and about 160 companies have joined.

In the special hall, compact electric truck from Cammsys has been displayed as an exemplary industrial convergence. Cammsys and Naver have worked on this together upon signing the MOU for co-developing electric car platform this April.
Auto parts companies Hyundai Mobis, SL, and MC Nex will be displaying their convergence technologies in auto-driving system and camera detection sensors.

Do Kyung-hwan, the industrial foundation head of MOTIE, said in the opening ceremony, "Korean companies should focus on increasing the value of their products by actively applying the new technology and creating new business opportunities by the convergence with other industries. The government will also support the companies by easing the regulation, provide the advantage in financial support, tax, and human resource, and upgrade the industrial environment."
